title: Chicken Cordon Bleu Pasta
reject_reason: Chicken with ham, Swiss, Dijon cream and panko is the cordon-bleu flavor identity already live as chicken-cordon-bleu-casserole (and turkey-cordon-bleu-casserole); egg-noodle skillet vs casserole is the same dinner reformatted, not a new plate.
